leads.detail: Actual address, implementation, proxy/admin state, request-ID binding, pricing, retry policy, liveness, and word provenance were not supplied.
Actual chain ID, token address, implementation, proxy/admin state, and official-USDC provenance were not supplied.
No claim is made that a deployed prize is malicious; the source permits the path and S6 reproduced it in isolation.
No deployed factory nonce, transaction order, selected recipient, or affected future-clone address was checked.
The precise frontend, indexer, and keeper revision was absent.
uint64(block.timestamp) narrowing at request and resolution lacks an explicit range guard.
Capabilities beyond IERC721Receiver remain unknowable without recipient implementations.
Chain-specific timestamp and sequencer behavior and live wrapper transactions were not exercised.
